group_summaries.brief_summary: OCaml 5.5.1 and opam 2.6.0~beta2 published to opam-repository while ocaml.org curated Planet feeds and announced opam 2.5.2.
group_summaries.new_features_summary: OCaml 5.5.1, opam 2.6.0~beta2, breaking tyxml 5.0.0, several new opam packages, and a new ocaml.org Planet feed.
group_summaries.new_features:
- **OCaml 5.5.1** published to [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) as `ocaml`, `ocaml-compiler`, `ocaml-base-compiler`, `ocaml-system`, `ocaml-src` and `ocaml-variants` by [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron), fixing the macOS switch-cloning failure from [ocaml/opam-repository#29496](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/issues/29496) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30637](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30637))
- **opam 2.6.0~beta2** published as 8 packages by [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30603](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30603)), while [ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org) separately carried the stable **opam 2.5.2** release announcement by the same author ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3712](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3712))
- CI on [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) now honours **`x-ci-accept-failures` on Windows** (`msys2-mingw`/`cygwin-mingw`), by [Samuel Hym](https://github.com/shym) ([ocaml/opam-repository#28856](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/28856))
- **tyxml 5.0.0** shipped with breaking API changes (typed `Xml.uri` attributes, SVG 2 documents, enumerated `hidden`/`contenteditable`) by [Vincent Balat](https://github.com/balat) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30641](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30641))
- New packages **`json-pointer`** and **`tdmrep`** by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30656](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30656), [ocaml/opam-repository#30616](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30616)), **`kube`** (Kubernetes client/controller runtime) by [Ville Vesilehto](https://github.com/thevilledev) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30662](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30662)), **`caps`** by [Yoann Padioleau](https://github.com/aryx) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30627](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30627)), **`amlc-lsp`** by [Christopher](https://github.com/chris-in-the-shell) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30622](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30622)), **`typegist`** alongside `jsont` 0.4.0 by [Daniel Bünzli](https://github.com/dbuenzli) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30614](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30614)), the **`pidgio`** family by [Xavier Van de Woestyne](https://github.com/xvw) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30638](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30638)), and **`obs-prometheus-eio`** by [Logan B. Nielsen](https://github.com/loganbnielsen) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30596](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30596))
- [ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org)'s OCaml Planet aggregator gained a new source, `gilwath.com`, filtered to caml-tagged posts only, by [Cuihtlauac Alvarado](https://github.com/cuihtlauac) ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3760](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3760))
group_summaries.group_overview:
- [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) published official **OCaml 5.5.1** ([ocaml/opam-repository#30637](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30637)) and **opam 2.6.0~beta2** ([ocaml/opam-repository#30603](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30603)), alongside a breaking **tyxml 5.0.0** release ([ocaml/opam-repository#30641](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30641)) and roughly a dozen new package submissions
- Maintainers on [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) increased scrutiny of automated/LLM-driven release patterns, closing or questioning several fast-iterating submissions ([ocaml/opam-repository#30623](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30623), [ocaml/opam-repository#30634](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30634), [ocaml/opam-repository#30643](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30643))
- [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org) focused on OCaml Planet feed curation — adding `gilwath` and disabling two dead feeds (`dinosaure`, `lthms`) — plus an opam 2.5.2 release announcement, jobs-page cleanup, and a CI flakiness investigation ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3760](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3760), [ocaml/ocaml.org#3763](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3763), [ocaml/ocaml.org#3712](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3712), [ocaml/ocaml.org#3764](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3764), [ocaml/ocaml.org#3759](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3759))
- Both repositories saw active involvement from [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) (new packages and account-authenticity scrutiny on [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository); Planet-aggregated blog posts on [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org)) and [Cuihtlauac Alvarado](https://github.com/cuihtlauac) (the `topup`/`river` packages on [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository); Planet curation and CI triage on [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org))
group_summaries.activity_summary: opam-repository saw rapid package iteration and policy scrutiny; ocaml.org completed Planet cleanup and opened a CI dependency-modeling issue.
group_summaries.activity:
- On [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository), [Calascibetta Romain](https://github.com/dinosaure) pushed a broad ecosystem update across `h1`, `miou`, `hurl`, `httpcats`, the 7-package `mnet` stack, `mhttp`, `vif` and `bstr` ([ocaml/opam-repository#30612](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30612)–[#30642](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30642)), while [Oscar Spencer](https://github.com/ospencer) released 8 rapid `binaryen`/`libbinaryen` version bumps ([ocaml/opam-repository#30650](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30650) and others)
- Several package releases needed 2-3 opened-and-closed iterations before merging, including `matcha` ([ocaml/opam-repository#30607](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30607), [ocaml/opam-repository#30617](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30617), [ocaml/opam-repository#30623](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30623)), `topup` ([ocaml/opam-repository#30562](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30562), [ocaml/opam-repository#30600](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30600), [ocaml/opam-repository#30602](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30602)) and `hegel` ([ocaml/opam-repository#30644](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30644)–[#30646](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30646))
- An automated `vscoqbot` PR for VSRocq 2.5.0 was closed pending human review, and [Enrico Tassi](https://github.com/gares) then opened and merged a corrected version ([ocaml/opam-repository#30643](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30643), [ocaml/opam-repository#30653](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30653))
- On [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org), [Cuihtlauac Alvarado](https://github.com/cuihtlauac) closed an opt-in feed-repair PR that would have pinned an unreleased `river` branch, favoring the simpler disable approach tracked in [ocaml/ocaml.org#3753](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3753) ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3756](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/pull/3756))
- [Cuihtlauac Alvarado](https://github.com/cuihtlauac) opened a CI flakiness issue on `hilite.markdown` missing at build time, traced to an unreleased git pin on `hilite` ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3759](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3759)), later investigated further by [Sahil Nayak](https://github.com/sahilnyk)
- [Daniel Lamping](https://github.com/daniellamping) removed two dead XenServer job listings from the jobs page after their links started 404ing ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3764](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3764))
group_summaries.cross_repository_work:
- [Cuihtlauac Alvarado](https://github.com/cuihtlauac) maintains `river` on [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository), publishing `river` 0.6 there ([ocaml/opam-repository#30611](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30611)), while on [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org) they explored (then withdrew) pinning an unreleased `river` branch to fix the MirageOS Planet feed's malformed HTML ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3756](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/pull/3756))
- opam versioning appeared on both repositories in the same week: [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) published the development **opam 2.6.0~beta2** ([ocaml/opam-repository#30603](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30603)) by [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate), while [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org) carried her release announcement for the prior stable **opam 2.5.2** ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3712](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3712))
- [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) submitted new packages to [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30656](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30656), [ocaml/opam-repository#30616](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30616)) in the same week that his blog posts were pulled into [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org)'s Planet aggregator ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3761](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3761), [ocaml/ocaml.org#3762](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3762))
- The [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org) CI flake on `hilite.markdown` ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3759](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3759)) depends on an upstream `hilite` 0.6.0 release being cut and eventually landing in [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository), mirroring the same release-then-unpin pattern used for `river`
group_summaries.notable_discussions:
- On [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository), repeated fast-iterating releases from [Andreas Eldh](https://github.com/eldh)'s `matcha` package prompted [Calascibetta Romain](https://github.com/dinosaure), [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) and [Raphaël Proust](https://github.com/raphael-proust) to question whether a human was driving the account, citing the repository's contributor-accounts policy ([ocaml/opam-repository#30617](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30617), [ocaml/opam-repository#30623](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30623))
- [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) raised similar authenticity concerns about [shoopeur-eng](https://github.com/shoopeur-eng)'s `realdentalcosts` submission, noting the submitting organisation was days old and spraying packages across repositories; the submitter withdrew ([ocaml/opam-repository#30634](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30634))
- [Dmitrii Kosarev](https://github.com/Kakadu) opened a discussion on whether packages with archived upstream repositories should themselves be archived in opam-repository ([ocaml/opam-repository#30550](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/issues/30550))
- On [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org)'s `hilite.markdown` CI issue, [Sahil Nayak](https://github.com/sahilnyk) found the proposed fix (releasing `hilite` 0.6.0) may not fully resolve the flake, since `fmt` is an unguarded dependency of the markdown sublibrary and proposed declaring it as a real `depends` ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3759](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3759))
group_summaries.emerging_trends:
- Maintainers on [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) ([Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm), [Calascibetta Romain](https://github.com/dinosaure), [Raphaël Proust](https://github.com/raphael-proust)) are increasingly pushing back on submitters whose release cadence or commit history suggests an automated or LLM-driven process without clear human oversight ([ocaml/opam-repository#30617](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30617), [ocaml/opam-repository#30623](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30623), [ocaml/opam-repository#30630](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30630), [ocaml/opam-repository#30634](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30634))
- The OCaml 5 ABI migration continues to surface old C bindings calling un-prefixed runtime allocation functions on [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository), fixed reactively with upper bounds rather than upstream patches ([ocaml/opam-repository#30661](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30661), [ocaml/opam-repository#30663](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30663))
- On [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org), the OCaml Planet dead-feed cleanup tracked in [ocaml/ocaml.org#3753](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3753) continues favoring disable-over-delete so archived posts keep resolving, and CI reliability work is shifting from symptom fixes toward root-cause opam dependency modeling ([ocaml/ocaml.org#3759](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3759))
- Routine maintenance PRs on [ocaml/ocaml.org](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org) continue to be authored with Claude Code assistance, per the "Generated with Claude Code" markers on [ocaml/ocaml.org#3758](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3758) and [ocaml/ocaml.org#3760](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml.org/issues/3760)

group_summaries.brief_summary: Dune moved dynamic actions onto RPC, opam shipped 2.6.0~beta2, ocaml-lsp merged 48 PRs, and odoc pursued OxCaml memory/disk work.
group_summaries.new_features_summary: Dune added RPC-based dynamic actions and qualified module refs; opam released 2.6.0~beta2; ocaml-lsp gained interactive completions.
group_summaries.new_features:
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: dynamic actions (used by ppxs and `dune ocaml top`) now run dynamic-run requests **over RPC** instead of an ad hoc sandbox protocol, by [Rudi Grinberg](https://github.com/rgrinberg) ([ocaml/dune#16256](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16256)), with follow-up fixes for deadlocks and missing dependencies ([ocaml/dune#16340](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16340), [ocaml/dune#16341](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16341), [ocaml/dune#16342](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16342), [ocaml/dune#16343](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16343), [ocaml/dune#16344](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16344)); this moves `read_directory_with_glob` from `Dune_action_plugin.V1` to `Dune_rpc_lwt.V1.Action_plugin`, a breaking change for dynamic-action plugin code.
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: **qualified module references** are now supported in fields such as `per_module` under `(include_subdirs qualified)`, by [Antonio Nuno Monteiro](https://github.com/anmonteiro) ([ocaml/dune#15633](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/15633), fixes [ocaml/dune#15578](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/issues/15578)), plus a fix for nested qualified module groups ([ocaml/dune#16322](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16322)) and a clearer error hint for invalid dotted references ([ocaml/dune#16152](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16152)).
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: `(env (env-vars ...))` in a `dune-workspace` `(context ...)` stanza now correctly takes precedence over the root `env` stanza, by [Puneeth Chaganti](https://github.com/punchagan) ([ocaml/dune#16290](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16290)); a crash on non-boolean opam command filters was also fixed by [art-w](https://github.com/art-w) ([ocaml/dune#16313](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16313)).
- **[ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam)**: **opam 2.6.0~beta2 released** by [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate) ([ocaml/opam#7115](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7115)), bundling a fix for a pinning **performance regression** that recursively scanned entire project trees (including `_build` and `.git`), also improving `opam update` performance by roughly 8% ([ocaml/opam#7101](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7101), fixes [ocaml/opam#7098](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7098)).
- **[ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam)**: dependency lockfile upgraded (`base64`, `spdx_licenses` 3.28.0, `menhir`, `patch`, `checkseum`) and release builds bumped to OCaml 4.14.4 ([ocaml/opam#7116](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7116)); install scripts updated with SHA512 checksums for the 2.6.0~beta2 binaries ([ocaml/opam#7119](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7119)); `conflicts` field documentation corrected by [Ryan Gibb](https://github.com/RyanGibb) ([ocaml/opam#7082](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7082)).
- **[ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp)**: generated **construct completions** (`match`/`function` skeletons) are now interactive with tab stops for clients with snippet support, by [Rudi Grinberg](https://github.com/rgrinberg) ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2198](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2198)).
- **[ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp)**: diagnostic locations derived from Merlin's formatted error messages are now converted to zero-based LSP line numbers, fixing `relatedInformation` ranges that pointed one line below the actual declaration ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2163](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2163), fixes [ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2145](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/issues/2145)); **find references** now honors the client's `includeDeclaration` flag ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2164](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2164)); **selection range** and **destruct-line** case analysis gained several correctness fixes ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2061](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2061), [ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2170](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2170), [ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2194](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2194)).
- **[ocaml/odoc](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc)**: a fix for OCaml 5.5 compatibility, correcting rendering of optional arguments wrapped in a `TPoly` constructor, was opened and merged by [Jon Ludlam](https://github.com/jonludlam) ([ocaml/odoc#1489](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1489)); **payload compression** on `.odoc`/`.odocl` files was proposed for a reported 4-5x size reduction ([ocaml/odoc#1486](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1486)).
group_summaries.group_overview:
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: reworked dynamic actions to run over RPC, added qualified module references, and closed roughly two dozen long-dormant draft PRs ([ocaml/dune#16256](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16256), [ocaml/dune#15633](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/15633)).
- **[ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam)**: released **2.6.0~beta2**, fixed a pinning performance regression, and upgraded its dependency lockfile ([ocaml/opam#7115](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7115), [ocaml/opam#7101](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7101)).
- **[ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp)**: merged 48 PRs, almost all by [Rudi Grinberg](https://github.com/rgrinberg), fixing rename/destruct/selection-range bugs, adding interactive construct completions, and migrating the e2e test suite to marked-source rendering ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2198](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2198)).
- **[ocaml/odoc](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc)**: ten PRs opened by [Jon Ludlam](https://github.com/jonludlam) covering path/signature resolution fixes and OxCaml-motivated memory/disk optimizations, with no merges landing on `master` mid-week beyond a couple of same-week fixes ([ocaml/odoc#1489](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1489), [ocaml/odoc#1487](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1487)).
- **[ocaml/merlin](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin)**: no commits landed on `main`; activity centered on the LRgrep error-message integration ([ocaml/merlin#2072](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin/issues/2072)), the `locate` fix under review ([ocaml/merlin#2118](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin/issues/2118)), and a sweep closing twelve stale Vim/Emacs issues by [Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac](https://github.com/panglesd).
- **[ocsigen/js_of_ocaml](https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml)**: a first-time contributor diagnosed and fixed a Safari 17 code-generation bug involving the `static` keyword in the same week ([ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2421](https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml/pull/2421), [ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2420](https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml/issues/2420)).
- **[ocaml/ocamlfind](https://github.com/ocaml/ocamlfind)**, **[ocaml/opam-file-format](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-file-format)**, and **[ocaml-dune/spawn](https://github.com/ocaml-dune/spawn)** had no recorded activity this week.
group_summaries.activity_summary: Dune advanced an incremental opam SAT solver and Melange work; opam progressed draft performance/Cygwin fixes; ocaml-lsp opened two features.
group_summaries.activity:
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: continued an incremental-solving push on its vendored **opam SAT solver** — a step/choose interface, incremental at-most groups, and a fuzzer checking incremental solutions against brute force, by [art-w](https://github.com/art-w) ([ocaml/dune#16294](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16294), [ocaml/dune#16304](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16304), [ocaml/dune#16298](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16298)) — alongside further qualified-module-reference tests and validation by [Antonio Nuno Monteiro](https://github.com/anmonteiro) ([ocaml/dune#16336](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16336), [ocaml/dune#16333](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16333)) and Melange emission-directory refactors ([ocaml/dune#16316](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16316), [ocaml/dune#16317](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16317)).
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: [Ali Caglayan](https://github.com/Alizter) closed a large batch of long-dormant draft and proof-of-concept PRs, including a `dune shell` debugging command experiment, as backlog cleanup ([ocaml/dune#15597](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/15597), [ocaml/dune#16217](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16217)); platform-stability fixes landed for macOS Xcode 15 compatibility and opam-promotion regressions ([ocaml/dune#16275](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16275), [ocaml/dune#16234](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16234)).
- **[ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam)**: new draft PRs target a speed-up of `OpamFile.OPAM.equal` for physically-equal parameters ([ocaml/opam#7124](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7124)), a release-script simplification ([ocaml/opam#7121](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7121)), and empty-argument handling for Cygwin process invocation ([ocaml/opam#7128](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7128), fixes [ocaml/opam#6714](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/6714)); [R. Boujbel](https://github.com/rjbou) asked for a test and changelog entry on the directory-scan-dedup PR ([ocaml/opam#7106](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7106)).
- **[ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp)**: **whole-call completions** for multi-argument functions ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2199](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2199)) and **record-pun expansion during rename** ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2065](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2065)) remain open, alongside an extensive e2e test-suite migration to marked-source rendering spanning around 20 PRs ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2172](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2172)-[ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2188](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2188)).
- **[ocaml/odoc](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc)**: [Jon Ludlam](https://github.com/jonludlam) opened correctness fixes for canonical chain search, extended `open` support, and module-type strengthening ([ocaml/odoc#1483](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1483), [ocaml/odoc#1482](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1482), [ocaml/odoc#1485](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1485)), plus memory-reduction work (docstring memoization, word-token merging) motivated by OxCaml's `ppx_template`-heavy codebases ([ocaml/odoc#1480](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1480), [ocaml/odoc#1488](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1488)); long-running OxCaml feature branches for `include functor`, parameterized libraries, and kind abbreviations continued under review ([ocaml/odoc#1452](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1452), [ocaml/odoc#1464](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1464), [ocaml/odoc#1467](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1467)).
- **[ocaml/merlin](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin)**: [Frédéric Bour](https://github.com/let-def) reported bug fixes and improved error messages on the LRgrep integration, now being ported to OCaml 5.5.1 ahead of an upstream compiler proposal ([ocaml/merlin#2072](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin/issues/2072)); the `locate` fix PR remains under review with disagreement over whether the fix belongs in `locate.ml` or the shared `inspect_browse_tree` function ([ocaml/merlin#2118](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin/issues/2118)).
group_summaries.cross_repository_work:
- **[ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp) depends directly on [ocaml/merlin](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin)'s error formatting**: a diagnostics bug fixed this week in ocaml-lsp stemmed from converting line numbers extracted from Merlin's formatted compiler messages, which had been off by one ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2163](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2163), fixes [ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2145](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/issues/2145)).
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune) tightened its Merlin integration**, fixing a case where Dune now prefers exact configuration matches when generating Merlin configuration for a project ([ocaml/dune#16194](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16194)), directly affecting how both [ocaml/merlin](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin) and [ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp) resolve editor tooling in Dune-managed projects.
- **Parallel opam-solver performance work across two codebases**: [ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune) pushed incremental-solving improvements to its own vendored opam SAT solver ([ocaml/dune#16294](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16294), [ocaml/dune#16304](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16304)) in the same week that [ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam) itself shipped a pinning-scan performance fix and opened an `OpamFile.OPAM.equal` speed-up ([ocaml/opam#7101](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7101), [ocaml/opam#7124](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7124)), reflecting a shared focus on opam package-resolution performance across the two independent implementations.
group_summaries.notable_discussions:
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: [Sudha Parimala](https://github.com/Sudha247) proposed a new `tool` stanza for declaring discretionary tools in `dune-workspace`, prompting [Shon Feder](https://github.com/shonfeder) to question overloading package-specification fields with both naming and version constraints ([ocaml/dune#16185](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/issues/16185)).
- **[ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)**: [sully-vian](https://github.com/sully-vian) and [Ali Caglayan](https://github.com/Alizter) debated why Dune rewrites `compile_commands.json` paths relative to `_build/default`, and why `clangd` fails to resolve them while `ccls` copes ([ocaml/dune#16225](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/issues/16225)).
- **[ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam)**: [Hannes Mehnert](https://github.com/hannesm) proposed integrating **opam-audit** security-vulnerability detection into `opam update`/`opam install` ([ocaml/opam#7113](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7113)); [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate) questioned fetching an OCaml-specific vulnerability database in a generic package manager, pointing to the existing `--ignore-available-on` flag ([ocaml/opam#6836](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/6836)).
- **[ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam)**: ongoing debate on **depexts naming** for derived Linux distributions, with [R. Boujbel](https://github.com/rjbou) noting a dev-meeting proposal for separate `os-package-manager`/`os-package-repository` variables ([ocaml/opam#4440](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/4440)), and whether `nix` or `nixos` should be the canonical `os-family` ([ocaml/opam#7087](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7087)).
- **[ocaml/merlin](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin)**: [Frédéric Bour](https://github.com/let-def) laid out the plan to eventually land the LRgrep-based error-reporting work in the OCaml compiler itself, using Merlin as a faster-iterating testbed, in response to questions from [Ulysse](https://github.com/voodoos) and [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) ([ocaml/merlin#2072](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin/issues/2072)).
- **[ocaml/odoc](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc)**: [Jon Ludlam](https://github.com/jonludlam) and [Paul-Elliot Anglès d'Auriac](https://github.com/panglesd) discussed a correctness concern in `include functor` support, where a generated `BODY` wrapper module needs recreating for each successive application so later applications see items from earlier ones ([ocaml/odoc#1452](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1452)).
- **[ocsigen/js_of_ocaml](https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml)**: [habakan](https://github.com/habakan) traced a Safari 17 `TypeError` back to a JavaScriptCore parsing quirk that misreads a line-wrapped `static` keyword as two separate class fields, reproduced via a shipped third-party artifact rather than a local build ([ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2420](https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml/issues/2420)).
group_summaries.emerging_trends:
- **Opam-solver performance work is happening independently in two codebases**: [ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune)'s vendored SAT solver is being made incremental ([ocaml/dune#16294](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16294), [ocaml/dune#16304](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16304)) while [ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam) itself lands pinning-scan and equality-check speed-ups ([ocaml/opam#7101](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7101), [ocaml/opam#7124](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7124)).
- **OxCaml compatibility is a recurring driver of work in [ocaml/odoc](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc)**, spanning memory/disk-footprint reductions for `ppx_template`-heavy codebases ([ocaml/odoc#1480](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1480), [ocaml/odoc#1486](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1486), [ocaml/odoc#1487](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1487)) and language-feature support for `include functor`, parameterized libraries, and kind abbreviations ([ocaml/odoc#1452](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1452), [ocaml/odoc#1464](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1464), [ocaml/odoc#1467](https://github.com/ocaml/odoc/issues/1467)).
- **Backlog cleanup and legacy-tooling redirection continued in editor-facing repos**: [ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune) closed roughly two dozen dormant draft PRs ([ocaml/dune#15597](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/15597)), while [ocaml/merlin](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin) closed a dozen stale Vim/Emacs issues, several redirecting users toward [ocaml-eglot](https://github.com/tarides/ocaml-eglot) ([ocaml/merlin#1354](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin/issues/1354), [ocaml/merlin#1738](https://github.com/ocaml/merlin/issues/1738)).
- **[ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp) paired a test-first pattern with a broad test-suite migration**, merging failing regression tests immediately before their fixes ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2032](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2032)/[ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2033](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2033)) while converting e2e tests across rename, destruct, and completion suites to marked-source rendering ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2172](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2172)-[ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2188](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2188)).

group_summaries.brief_summary: Atomic pointers, DWARF-5 debug info, and dependency vendoring landed in oxcaml/oxcaml, while opam-repository relaxed dune/eio/mdx guards.
group_summaries.new_features_summary: New atomic pointer primitives, DWARF-5 debug flag, [@@or_null] GADTs, all-void constructors, and relaxed dune/eio/mdx opam version guards.
group_summaries.new_features:
- New **atomic pointer primitives** (`%unsafe_atomic_load_ptr`, `%unsafe_atomic_set_ptr`, `%unsafe_atomic_exchange_ptr`, `%unsafe_atomic_cas_ptr`, `%unsafe_atomic_fetch_add_ptr`) implemented by [Joe Kerrigan](https://github.com/joe-kerrigan) in [oxcaml/oxcaml#6747](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6747), with follow-ups avoiding an extra shift+tag on `idx_atomic` field access ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6802](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6802)) and relaxing the `idx_atomic` kind constraint ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6831](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6831))
- New `-gdwarf-version <4|5>` **compiler flag** for DWARF-5 output, added by [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) in [oxcaml/oxcaml#6923](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6923); cuts `.debug_loc`/`.debug_ranges` payload by roughly 26% on the compiler itself, building on compact DWARF forms for small constants and high PC offsets ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6922](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6922))
- `[@@or_null]` types now support **GADTs**, including a missing partial-match-warning fix, from [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) and [Nathanaëlle Courant](https://github.com/Ekdohibs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6981](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6981))
- Constructors whose arguments are **all-`void`** can now be represented as statically-allocated block atoms without the `[@immediate_all_void_constructor]` attribute, by [Ryan Tjoa](https://github.com/rtjoa) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6880](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6880))
- Fixed an **allocation-pointer bug on stack overflow** that could corrupt recently-allocated values, and a related **C stack alignment** bug that could crash in TCMalloc, both by [Nick Barnes](https://github.com/NickBarnes) after production sightings ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7020](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7020), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7088](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7088))
- `ppxlib`, `sedlex`, `js_of_ocaml` and `ocaml-compiler-libs` began being **vendored directly into oxcaml/oxcaml as git subtrees** and compiled in-tree rather than pulled from opam, by [Robin Ricard](https://github.com/rricard) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7011](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7011)-[oxcaml/oxcaml#7074](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7074) series)
- In **oxcaml/opam-repository**, version guards on 24 `oxcaml-*` packages (dune, eio, mdx dependents) were narrowed so compatibility patches no longer apply once upstream `dune` >= 3.24.2, `eio` >= 1.4, or `mdx` >= 2.6.0 is installed, by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([oxcaml/opam-repository#59](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/59))
- A `wasm_of_ocaml` runtime link failure under dune 3.24 (where `%{deps}` now expands paths with a leading `./`) was fixed in `runtime/wasm/args.ml`, backported from [ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2371](https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml/pull/2371) and applied across `wasm_of_ocaml-compiler` 6.0.1+ox1, 6.0.1+ox2, and 6.3.2+ox, by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([oxcaml/opam-repository#59](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/59))
group_summaries.group_overview:
- **oxcaml/oxcaml** carried the bulk of the group's activity: new atomic pointer primitives, DWARF-5 debug info, `[@@or_null]` GADT support, two production bug fixes, and the start of vendoring external dependencies as in-repo git subtrees
- **oxcaml/opam-repository** merged version-guard relaxations for `dune` 3.24.2+, `eio` 1.4+, and `mdx` 2.6.0+ ([oxcaml/opam-repository#59](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/59)) alongside a `wasm_of_ocaml` runtime link fix, with a `zarith` fix ([oxcaml/opam-repository#61](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/61)) and a `dune-ignore` patch fix ([oxcaml/opam-repository#60](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/60)) newly opened
- **janestreet/opam-repository** saw a single issue reporting that `expect_test_sexp_diff` is missing from the public release, affecting test suites for `incremental`, `incr_map`, and `ppx_css` ([janestreet/opam-repository#76](https://github.com/janestreet/opam-repository/issues/76))
- **oxcaml/merlin** and **oxcaml/js_of_ocaml** had no recorded activity this week
group_summaries.activity_summary: New PRs opened on LTO, metaprogramming, and mode polymorphism in oxcaml; opam-repository opened zarith/dune-ignore fixes and merged guard relaxations.
group_summaries.activity:
- **oxcaml/oxcaml** saw a large batch of new PRs: an LTO prototype by [Simon Spies](https://github.com/spiessimon) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7156](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7156)), calling-convention and slot-offset work for LTO by [Miriam Vellacott](https://github.com/mirivella) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7030](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7030), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6992](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6992), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7068](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7068), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7082](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7082)), and a metaprogramming/unloadable-compilation-unit series by [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7032](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7032)-[oxcaml/oxcaml#7050](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7050))
- **Mode polymorphism/modality** typing infrastructure expanded with new PRs from [@ainageorges](https://github.com/ainageorges) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7025](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7025), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7056](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7056), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7098](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7098)) and [@dkalinichenko-js](https://github.com/dkalinichenko-js) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6352](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6352), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6762](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6762), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7095](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7095)); merged typing-internals work included functors affected by modalities ([oxcaml/oxcaml#5371](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/5371)) and jkind normalization refactoring ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6393](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6393))
- Atomics work broadened with [Joe Kerrigan](https://github.com/joe-kerrigan) adding atomic `ext_ptr` support ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6937](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6937)) and [Aspen Smith](https://github.com/glittershark) opening acquire/release atomic load and store primitives ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7048](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7048))
- A **fuzzer MVP** generating random oxcaml programs was opened by [@hwasilewskijs](https://github.com/hwasilewskijs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6933](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6933)), alongside Datalog-based validators for CFG passes from the same author ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6564](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6564), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6673](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6673), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7076](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7076))
- **Removal and reversion churn** around unboxed numeric types: `int64#`, `int32#`, `nativeint#` and `float32#` were removed by [Ryan Tjoa](https://github.com/rtjoa) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6663](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6663)) and reverted the same week ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7058](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7058))
- The **reaper** gained an `-Oclassic` compatibility mode, reverted and reinstated after CI fallout, by [Nathanaëlle Courant](https://github.com/Ekdohibs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6993](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6993), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7067](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7067), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7075](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7075)); LTO progressed with a `.ltosol` solution-file cache by [Miriam Vellacott](https://github.com/mirivella) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6964](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6964), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7118](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7118))
- **oxcaml/opam-repository**: a `zarith.1.14+ox` minus39 installability fix ([oxcaml/opam-repository#61](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/61)) and a `dune-ignore` patch fix for `oxcaml-compiler` ([oxcaml/opam-repository#60](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/60)) were opened by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) and [Shun Ueda](https://github.com/shunueda) respectively; an earlier `mdx.2.6.0` compatibility PR by [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27-js) ([oxcaml/opam-repository#55](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/55)) was closed once superseded by [oxcaml/opam-repository#59](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/59)
- **janestreet/opam-repository**: [Stefan Muenzel](https://github.com/smuenzel) opened an issue reporting `expect_test_sexp_diff` (and possibly `expect_test_graphviz`) missing from the public release ([janestreet/opam-repository#76](https://github.com/janestreet/opam-repository/issues/76))
group_summaries.cross_repository_work:
- **oxcaml/oxcaml** began vendoring external dependencies — including a fork of **oxcaml/js_of_ocaml**, plus `ppxlib`, `sedlex`, and `ocaml-compiler-libs` — directly into its own tree as git subtrees compiled in-tree, by [Robin Ricard](https://github.com/rricard) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7011](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7011)-[oxcaml/oxcaml#7074](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7074)), reducing reliance on the same packages tracked separately as opam patches in **oxcaml/opam-repository**
- Findlib/`ocamlfind` support was removed from **oxcaml/merlin**'s `dot-merlin-reader` by [Liam Stevenson](https://github.com/liam923) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6952](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6952)), simplifying Merlin's inclusion directly in the **oxcaml/oxcaml** compiler distribution rather than via opam
- [Gavin Gray](https://github.com/gavinleroy)'s series on Merlin/compiler-artifact integration in **oxcaml/oxcaml** — module-type information in `.cms`/merlin-index artifacts, a `module-type-impls` query, synchronized Merlin import, and annotation provenance import ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6801](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6801), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6811](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6811), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6872](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6872), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6891](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6891)) — deepens integration between the compiler and **oxcaml/merlin** tooling
- The **oxcaml/opam-repository** `wasm_of_ocaml` dune-3.24 runtime link fix ([oxcaml/opam-repository#59](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/59)) was backported from [ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2371](https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml/pull/2371), upstream of the **oxcaml/js_of_ocaml** fork now being vendored into **oxcaml/oxcaml**
group_summaries.notable_discussions:

group_summaries.new_features_summary: Native arm64/power rounding instructions, Windows Unix.select and thread-starvation fixes, and a Haiku native backend landed on trunk.
group_summaries.new_features:
- POWER **assembler fix** for stack frames whose offsets exceed a 16-bit signed immediate in loads, stores, `addi`, and `li`, by [Tim McGilchrist](https://github.com/tmcgilchrist) ([ocaml/ocaml#15021](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15021))
- Native **rounding instructions** for `Float.round`, `Float.trunc`, `ceil`, and `floor` now emitted directly on arm64 and power instead of calling into C, by [Zane Hambly](https://github.com/Zaneham) ([ocaml/ocaml#15017](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15017))
- Two bugs fixed in the **Win32 implementation of `Unix.select`** that could return incorrect results or fail when the same file descriptor appeared more than once across the input lists, by [Nicolás Ojeda Bär](https://github.com/nojb) ([ocaml/ocaml#15025](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15025))
- Fixed a **Windows thread-starvation bug** where a thread that never yielded voluntarily could hold the runtime lock forever, blocking preemptive switching between systhreads, by [Nicolás Ojeda Bär](https://github.com/nojb), reported by [Daniel Larraz](https://github.com/daniel-larraz) ([ocaml/ocaml#15029](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15029), fixing [ocaml/ocaml#15028](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15028), backported to trunk in [ocaml/ocaml#15034](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15034))
- **Haiku/BeOS native-code backend** activated, with Unix socket tests and single-threaded `setlocale`/signal handling, by [Anarchos](https://github.com/Sylvain78) ([ocaml/ocaml#14773](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14773))
- **Security fix**: `Marshal.data_size` now guards against integer overflow when computing `header_len + data_len`, by [Xavier Leroy](https://github.com/xavierleroy) ([ocaml/ocaml#15030](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15030)), shipped in the [OCaml 5.5.1](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/releases/tag/5.5.1) release published this week
- Fixed an **uncaught `Sys_error`** raised when flushing standard formatters at program exit, by [Olivier Nicole](https://github.com/OlivierNicole), reported by [Olivier Andrieu](https://github.com/oandrieu) ([ocaml/ocaml#15026](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15026), fixing [ocaml/ocaml#14765](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14765))
- `Runtime_events.runtime_phase` gained the missing `EV_MINOR_EPHE_CLEAN` constructor, and the `EV_C_MINOR_ALLOCATED_WORDS` counter now reports the correct unit, by [Tim McGilchrist](https://github.com/tmcgilchrist) ([ocaml/ocaml#14966](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14966), [ocaml/ocaml#14969](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14969))

- __RUMINANT:core__ Native **rounding instructions** for `Float.round`/`trunc`/`ceil`/`floor` now emit directly on arm64 and power instead of calling into C, by [Zane Hambly](https://github.com/Zaneham) ([ocaml/ocaml#15017](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15017)), alongside a POWER assembler fix for large stack-frame offsets by [Tim McGilchrist](https://github.com/tmcgilchrist) ([ocaml/ocaml#15021](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15021)).
- __RUMINANT:core__ Two **Win32 `Unix.select`** correctness bugs and a **Windows thread-starvation** bug that could hold the runtime lock forever were fixed by [Nicolás Ojeda Bär](https://github.com/nojb) ([ocaml/ocaml#15025](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15025), [ocaml/ocaml#15029](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15029), backported in [ocaml/ocaml#15034](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15034)).
- __RUMINANT:core__ The **Haiku/BeOS native-code backend** was activated on trunk by [Anarchos](https://github.com/Sylvain78) ([ocaml/ocaml#14773](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14773)).
- __RUMINANT:ecosystem__ [ocaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository) published **OCaml 5.5.1** as `ocaml`/`ocaml-compiler`/`ocaml-base-compiler`/`ocaml-system` packages by [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30637](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30637)) and **opam 2.6.0~beta2** as 8 packages by [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30603](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30603)).
- __RUMINANT:tools__ [ocaml/opam](https://github.com/ocaml/opam) released [**opam 2.6.0~beta2**](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/releases/tag/2.6.0-beta2) by [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate) ([ocaml/opam#7115](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7115)), fixing a pinning **performance regression** that recursively scanned entire project trees and improving `opam update` performance by roughly 8% ([ocaml/opam#7101](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7101), fixes [ocaml/opam#7098](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7098)).
- __RUMINANT:tools__ [ocaml/dune](https://github.com/ocaml/dune) moved dynamic actions (used by ppxs and `dune ocaml top`) onto **RPC** instead of an ad hoc sandbox protocol, by [Rudi Grinberg](https://github.com/rgrinberg) ([ocaml/dune#16256](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/16256)), a breaking change for dynamic-action plugin code, plus five follow-up deadlock/dependency fixes; **qualified module references** are now supported under `(include_subdirs qualified)` by [Antonio Nuno Monteiro](https://github.com/anmonteiro) ([ocaml/dune#15633](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/pull/15633)).
- __RUMINANT:tools__ [ocaml/ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp) merged 48 PRs including **interactive construct completions** with tab stops by [Rudi Grinberg](https://github.com/rgrinberg) ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2198](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2198)) and a fix for off-by-one diagnostic line numbers ([ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2163](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/pull/2163), fixes [ocaml/ocaml-lsp#2145](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp/issues/2145)).
- __RUMINANT:oxcaml__ [oxcaml/oxcaml](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml) added new **atomic pointer primitives** (`%unsafe_atomic_load_ptr` and friends) by [Joe Kerrigan](https://github.com/joe-kerrigan) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6747](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6747)) and a `-gdwarf-version <4|5>` flag for **DWARF-5** output cutting debug-info size roughly 26%, by [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6923](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6923)).
- __RUMINANT:oxcaml__ Two **production bugs** were fixed by [Nick Barnes](https://github.com/NickBarnes): an allocation-pointer corruption on stack overflow, and a C-stack-alignment crash under TCMalloc ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7020](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7020), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7088](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7088)).
- __RUMINANT:multicore__ [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio) merged a typed **`Eio.Process.Env`** module replacing raw `string array` environments on `Process.spawn`/`run`/`parse_out`, with Windows case-insensitive name handling, by [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#930](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/pull/930)).
- __RUMINANT:ecosystem__ New opam packages **`json-pointer`** and **`tdmrep`** by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30656](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30656), [ocaml/opam-repository#30616](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30616)) and **`kube`**, a Kubernetes client, by [Ville Vesilehto](https://github.com/thevilledev) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30662](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30662)); **tyxml 5.0.0** shipped breaking API changes by [Vincent Balat](https://github.com/balat) ([ocaml/opam-repository#30641](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30641)).

- __RUMINANT:core__ **Windows/Win32 work** clustered across the week: [Nicolás Ojeda Bär](https://github.com/nojb) landed the `Unix.select` and thread-starvation fixes ([ocaml/ocaml#15025](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15025), [ocaml/ocaml#15029](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15029)), while new reports on stop-the-world barrier latency ([ocaml/ocaml#15042](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15042)) and failing in-prefix CI tests ([ocaml/ocaml#15040](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15040)) were opened.
- __RUMINANT:core__ [Tim McGilchrist](https://github.com/tmcgilchrist) closed out **runtime-events** fixes for a missing `EV_MINOR_EPHE_CLEAN` constructor and a counter-unit bug ([ocaml/ocaml#14966](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14966), [ocaml/ocaml#14969](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14969)), and [Nicolás Ojeda Bär](https://github.com/nojb) merged a complexity improvement for `Set.{union,inter,diff}` ([ocaml/ocaml#15009](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15009)).

weekly_summary.notable_discussions:
- __RUMINANT:core__ The **link-time linking** proposal from [Raphaël Proust](https://github.com/raphael-proust) drew security objections from [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate) about silently executing arbitrary scripts and a design critique from [Daniel Bünzli](https://github.com/dbuenzli) on shell-quoted environment variables ([ocaml/ocaml#14895](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14895)).
- __RUMINANT:core__ The **bit-counting primitives** PR sparked debate between [Xavier Leroy](https://github.com/xavierleroy), who split the proposal into an uncontroversial and a more debatable half, and [Basile Clément](https://github.com/bclement-ocp), who flagged lost flambda constant propagation ([ocaml/ocaml#15018](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/15018)).
- __RUMINANT:oxcaml__ On the production-observed stack-overflow allocation-pointer bug, [Nick Barnes](https://github.com/NickBarnes) initially misattributed the incident before correcting it to the related C-stack-alignment fix, and [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) noted a related runtime comment may need revisiting ([oxcaml/oxcaml#7020](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7020), [oxcaml/oxcaml#7088](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/7088)).
- __RUMINANT:oxcaml__ On [oxcaml/opam-repository#59](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/59), [George Shammas](https://github.com/georgyo) reported pinning back to `dune 3.22.2+ox` because dune 3.24's `%{deps}` leading-`./` expansion ([ocaml/dune#15156](https://github.com/ocaml/dune/issues/15156)) breaks `bonsai_web` via `ppx_css`'s `css_inliner`.
- __RUMINANT:multicore__ [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5), [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) and [Patrick Ferris](https://github.com/patricoferris) debated environment-variable name comparison case-sensitivity, settling on Windows-only case-insensitivity plus an upper-case naming convention ([ocaml-multicore/eio#930](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/pull/930)).
- __RUMINANT:ecosystem__ Repeated fast-iterating releases from [Andreas Eldh](https://github.com/eldh)'s `matcha` package prompted [Calascibetta Romain](https://github.com/dinosaure), [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) and [Raphaël Proust](https://github.com/raphael-proust) to question whether a human was driving the account ([ocaml/opam-repository#30617](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30617), [ocaml/opam-repository#30623](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/30623)).
- __RUMINANT:tools__ [Hannes Mehnert](https://github.com/hannesm) proposed integrating **opam-audit** security-vulnerability detection into `opam update`/`opam install`, while [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate) questioned fetching an OCaml-specific vulnerability database in a generic package manager ([ocaml/opam#7113](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/7113), [ocaml/opam#6836](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/issues/6836)).
